ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 RET NUMBER;
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100);
 v_count number(5); 
 BEGIN 

SELECT COUNT(1) INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS
( SELECT 1 
 FROM activity_transactions act,
 insptr_dcltns ID,
 declarations d
 
 WHERE 
 act.port_cd = :p_port_cd
 AND ((:rad_select = 1 AND act.user_id = :user_id) OR 
 (:rad_select = 2 AND D.DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN))
 AND act.sysobj_id = 21
 AND act.subj_code = 15
 AND act.actvy_sub_id = ID.port_cd||'!'||ID.assign_isn
 AND d.port_cd = ID.port_cd
 AND d.dcltn_isn = ID.dcltn_isn
 );

if v_count > 0 then

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_dcltn_isn',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CLASS_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_CLASS_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_ID);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'RAD_SELECT',TEXT_PARAMETER, :RAD_SELECT);
 
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_USER_ID',TEXT_PARAMETER,:USER_ID);

 
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS ,V_REPORT_FILE, SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
 MESSAGE('لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب'); 
 MESSAGE(' لا يوجد سجلات تحقق المطلوب');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END IF;



END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_DCLTN_NBR
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_DCLTN_NBR IS
 DSC NUMBER(2):=0;
 RET NUMBER;
 v_cnt NUMBER;
 P_KEY VARCHAR(20);
 AC_COUNT NUMBER;
BEGIN 
 IF (:DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL OR :DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL OR :DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL) THEN
 SELECT DCLTN_NBR,DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT,DCLTN_TYPE_CD, TYPE_NAME 
 INTO :DCLTN_NBR,:DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_DT,:DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :DCLTN_TYPE_DESC
 FROM DECLARATIONS, DCLTN_TYPES
 WHERE (PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD OR :DCLTN_DT IS NULL )AND 
 (DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR OR :DCLTN_DT IS NULL )AND
 (DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_DT OR :DCLTN_DT IS NULL )AND
 (DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN OR :DCLTN_ISN IS NULL)AND
 TYPE_ID = DCLTN_TYPE_CD ;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
-------------------------------------------------------
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :DCLTN_NBR := NULL;
 :DCLTN_DT := NULL;
 :DCLTN_ISN := NULL;
 :DCLTN_TYPE_DESC := NULL;
 STR.dispalert('معلومات البيان المدخلة غير صحيحة','ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
-------------------------------------------------------- 
 WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
 CALL_LOV_DCLTNS;
END;

PROCEDURE CALL_LOV_DCLTNS IS

 RET NUMBER;
 D DATE;
BEGIN
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name);
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN

 no_replace,
 no_query_only,

 IF :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 :DCLTN_DT := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_DT;
 :DCLTN_ISN := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_ISN;
 :DCLTN_NBR := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_NBR ;
 :DCLTN_TYPE_CD := :GLOBAL.DCLTN_TYPE_CD;
 IF (:DCLTN_NBR IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_DT IS NOT NULL AND :DCLTN_ISN IS NOT NULL) THEN
 SELECT DCLTN_NBR,DCLTN_ISN,DCLTN_DT,DCLTN_TYPE_CD, TYPE_NAME 
 INTO :DCLTN_NBR,:DCLTN_ISN,:DCLTN_DT,:DCLTN_TYPE_CD, :DCLTN_TYPE_DESC
 FROM DECLARATIONS, DCLTN_TYPES
 WHERE (PORT_CD = :P_PORT_CD OR :DCLTN_DT IS NULL )AND 
 (DCLTN_NBR = :DCLTN_NBR OR :DCLTN_DT IS NULL )AND
 (DCLTN_DT = :DCLTN_DT OR :DCLTN_DT IS NULL )AND
 (DCLTN_ISN = :DCLTN_ISN OR :DCLTN_ISN IS NULL)AND
 TYPE_ID = DCLTN_TYPE_CD ;
 END IF;
 
 END IF;
 Destroy_Parameter_List(pl_id);
 ELSE
 ret := Str.DispAlert('Parameter list '||pl_name||' already exists!','INFORMATION');
 :DCLTN_ISN:=NULL;
 :DCLTN_NBR:=NULL;
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;

END;

PROCEDURE SET_VISUAL_ATT IS
 cur_itm VARCHAR2(80);
 cur_itm_FULL VARCHAR2(80);
 cur_block VARCHAR2(80):=:System.Cursor_Block;
 
BEGIN
-------------------------------------SETING PROMPTS,WIDTHS & POSITIONS-------------------------------------
cur_itm:=Get_Block_Property(cur_block,FIRST_ITEM );

WHILE(cur_itm IS NOT NULL ) LOOP
cur_itm_FULL :=cur_block||'.'||cur_itm;

 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,ENABLED)= 'FALSE' AND 
 GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,ITEM_TYPE) NOT IN ('BUTTON','RADIO GROUP') THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'CG$DISPLAY_ITEM');
 
 ELSIF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,ENABLED)= 'TRUE' AND 
 GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,ITEM_TYPE) NOT IN ('BUTTON','RADIO GROUP')
 THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY(cur_itm_FULL,VISUAL_ATTRIBUTE,'CG$ITEM');
 END IF;
 cur_itm := Get_Item_Property(cur_itm_FULL,NEXTITEM);

END LOOP;

END;
